desc: a guest's link that keeps hanging open below the lag limit (fix-021, 6.4, 19.6.7, W7g's shape for a guest): from @200 the proxy holds b's packets for 7 s at a time, 0.2 s apart (eight half-open cuts). Each cut stays below Relay:LagLeaveSeconds (10 s) and b's pads of the last ticks before each window come in time, so its fill streak ends every time; its lag debt (the ticks its slot held a up minus its ticks in time) reaches 10 s in the second cut and the lag rule takes b out of a's stage group (lag_leave why=lag_debt): b plays on apart with its seat, a leads on alone, the instance goes on. Before, b stayed in a's stage group for good
